name: Sister Aquinne
summary: In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne studies beneath the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. She serves in the Temple Gardens as a novice acolyte.

sections.title: Acolyte in Darnassus
sections.body: Sister Aquinne studies with the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. She learns in the Temple Gardens beneath the Temple of the Moon, guided by the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest needed help, Aquinne sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what must be done.

faq.q: Where can Sister Aquinne be found?
faq.answer: Sister Aquinne can be found in the Temple Gardens of Darnassus, just outside the Temple of the Moon.
Sister Aquinne is a novice priestess of Elune, studying at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Little is known of her life before she entered the temple's service.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see Aquinne's devotion in the foundational training she undertakes as an acolyte of the Temple of the Moon.
As a night elf arriving in Darnassus, you can meet Sister Aquinne in the Temple Gardens and glimpse the temple priesthood.
